May I speak plainly? Trump has turned the American economy into sh*t. 

Let me explain what's happened: robertreich.substack.com/p/h…

53 years ago today, the last U.S. combat troops left South Vietnam, ending America’s direct role in the Vietnam War.

I remember seeing this anti-war PSA back then. Its message is sadly still very relevant today as Trump drags us into another unpopular war.

Video

Yesterday, millions of us once again affirmed the foundation of the common good. But how do we turn yesterday’s solidarity into political power? Here are three suggestions. robertreich.substack.com/p/s…

Today and everyday, we say No Kings in America.

Here's what we must do next.

Video

Trump has launched us into an unpopular war, tanked the economy, and unleashed a masked army of thugs to terrorize communities all over the country.

Heather and I discuss why the Mad King’s actions makes today's No Kings 3 marches all the more important on this week’s Coffee Klatch.

piped.video/RlbaeBp0c4w

As we resist tyranny, America gains solidarity.

As we gain solidarity, we build courage.

As we feel courageous and stand up to Trump, we weaken him and his regime.

Let's continue to build solidarity by peacefully opposing our tyrant-in-chief today at No Kings protests across the country.

Donald Trump paused his wartime cabinet meeting for a critical discussion ... about Sharpies?

Video

Tomorrow, across America, we have another opportunity to make our opposition to the Trump regime visible, loud, and clear. Are you planning to join a No Kings protest where you live? robertreich.substack.com/p/o…

Was this insider trading?

Video

Yesterday, a young woman prevailed in a lawsuit against Meta and YouTube in which she accused them of designing their apps to be as addictive and harmful to kids as cigarettes. This is a big deal. But more needs to be done. robertreich.substack.com/p/h…
We need to talk about this... robertreich.substack.com/p/t…

This No Kings Day on March 28 is more important than ever.

Find your local protest at nokings.org

Video

Flying already sucks.

It’s about to get a whole lot worse as Trump sends armed ICE agents to airports to deal with TSA shortages.

But that’s not even the whole story. Watch.

Video

So what will America have gotten out of Trump’s “excursion” in Iran? Zilch. Actually, less than zilch because in many ways we’re worse off than when it started. But that won't stop him from declaring "victory." Some thoughts... robertreich.substack.com/p/t…

Nexstar and Tegna’s merger was just given a special green light by Trump’s FCC.

Never heard of these companies? Well, they could soon control your local news stations. Watch.

Video

Tyranny cannot succeed where people refuse to submit to it.

Next Saturday, on the third No Kings Day, we will proclaim our refusal to submit. 

We will reaffirm that America Belongs to us. Some thoughts...
robertreich.substack.com/p/s…

You might hear people say that protesting doesn’t make a difference.

Leah Greenberg of Indivisible shares why that’s not true.

Video

Trump has no plan for his war on Iran.

He can’t even come up with a coherent justification for it.

Meanwhile, his economy is tanking and even some of his supporters are jumping ship.

Is this the week the tide turns on him for good? piped.video/VgiQmE71XuY

Yesterday, Trump said that he’d do whatever is necessary to ease the oil crisis. He also assured America that the crisis “will be over soon.” I'm calling bullshit. Here's why he's trapped in Iran.

Should corporations be able to weaponize your personal data to rip you off?

Well, they may already be doing that thanks to a shady tactic called “surveillance pricing.”

Former FTC Chair Lina Khan explains what we can do about it. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-cbtUYshYM8

Your tax season reminder that the real freeloaders in this country are the rich — not the poor or immigrants or any other group of people vilified as scapegoats. The richest 1% evade $160 billion in taxes every year. The United States literally has yacht and private jet tax deductions. Hello?
The call is coming from inside the house.
10 years ago, Bernie Sanders warned America of the unintended consequences that could emerge from a regime change war with Iran. Watch.

From time to time, I post here transcripts I’ve come across of particularly insightful conversations. Here’s one that’s particularly relevant to this past weekend's No Kings Day protests. https://robertreich.substack.com/p/what-americans-can-learn-from-other

Donald Trump, Jr.'s VC firm invested in a startup that produces rare-earth magnets for military equipment.

Months later, the Pentagon awarded the company a $620M loan.

Remember that Don Jr. also has a stake in a drone company that recently received defense contracts.

Coincidence? Or corruption?

Under Trump, the CFTC has dropped investigations into Kalshi and Polymarket, announced its opposition to states’ attempts to regulate them, and made no moves to crack down on insider trading.

Donald Trump, Jr. is an advisor to both Kalshi and Polymarket.

Always follow the money.

Last year, Trump signed executive orders to fast-track AI data center construction and weaken state-level AI regulations.

Now a new AI industry group says it will spend $100M+ on the midterms to push Trump's AI agenda.

Money in politics is the root of our dysfunction.

Be warned.

Architectural experts are now warning that Trump's rushed White House ballroom is riddled with serious design flaws.

That might not even matter to the billionaires financing the project  — as long as Trump gives them their kickbacks and political favors. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Nbf6BJzpk1E

NEW: Trump pardoned nursing home owner Joseph Schwartz just 3 months into his sentence for a $39 million fraud scheme.

Meanwhile, families who won multimillion-dollar wrongful death suits against Schwartz haven’t collected a cent.

What’s Next After No Kings 3?
Tuesday, March 31
8pm – 9pm EDT
www.mobilize.us/nokings/even...

At our March 31 Mass Call, you'll hear from leaders and fellow local activists to celebrate this historic mobilization and dig into what comes next. Join us.

#NoKings #WhatsNext

Republicans want to gut federal health spending again.

First, they gutted Medicaid and other crucial programs to pay for tax cuts for the super-rich and corporations.

Now, they want more healthcare cuts so they can bankroll Trump’s war on Iran.

Priorities.

The first 14 months of Trump's second term have been the most deadly for ICE detainees since the pandemic.

Some of Trump's biggest supporters are private prison corporations that have received huge government contracts to run these camps.

Cashing in on cruelty.
It’s not about what this country can or can’t afford. It’s about priorities.
Never forget who is really winning this war. https://www.commondreams.org/news/iran-war-big-oil
